recalls.description: CPSC product recalls (SaferProducts.gov Recall API): one row per recall with products, units, hazards, remedies, injuries, manufacturers, retailers and importers. Give at least one filter; text filters match part of the field.

RecallDateStart.desc: recalls announced on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

RecallDateEnd.desc: recalls announced on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

LastPublishDateStart.desc: recalls published or updated on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

ProductName.desc: part of a product name (crib, dresser)

ProductType.desc: part of CPSC's product type (Slides, Cribs, Dressers)

Retailer.desc: part of the retailer text (Amazon, Walmart)

Injury.desc: part of the injuries text (death, burn)

Remedy.desc: part of the remedy text (Refund, Repair, Replace)

hazard.desc: keep recalls whose hazard text contains this (case-insensitive); filtered here, because the API's own Hazard filter matches nothing

country.desc: keep recalls with this manufacturer country (China, Vietnam); filtered here

neiss.description: NEISS: one year of emergency-department injury cases involving consumer products (about 300,000 sampled cases a year, with national weights). Manual only: cpsc.gov refuses scripts; the user downloads the archived year as Tab Delimited Text (or Excel) and uploads it.

product.desc: keep cases with this NEISS product code in Product_1, Product_2 or Product_3 (a code or a list; the codes are in the NEISS Coding Manual)
